primary.description: Deep presidential navy - used in header logo area and primary brand identity

secondary.description: Dark navy blue - used in CTA buttons and dark section backgrounds

accent.description: Bright blue - used for interactive links and highlights

gradients.name: schedule-banner
gradients.usage: Calendar/schedule section background - vivid purple-blue-pink gradient

color.mood: Authoritative, trustworthy, patriotic. Deep navy conveys governmental gravity. Minimal color palette emphasizes content over decoration. Purple-pink gradient in schedule section provides modern, forward-looking contrast.

heading_font.usage: Primary typeface for all headings and body text

body_font.usage: Same family for body, achieving visual unity

accent_font.usage: Serif/명조 for emotional hero headlines - section titles like '대통령의 순간들'. Provides literary, authoritative feel.

weight_usage.300: Light - hero description text for softer feel
weight_usage.400: Regular - body text, captions, dates (dominant weight)
weight_usage.600: Semibold - section titles, CTA buttons, important links
weight_usage.700: Bold - hero headline, card titles, navigation emphasis

special.hero_headline: 68px/bold Pretendard, very large for impact. Multi-line Korean text with natural word-breaking.
special.section_title: Nanum_Myeongjo serif at 55-64px creates contrast against Pretendard sans-serif body

layout.pattern: Full-width sections, no visible max-width container. Content bleeds edge-to-edge with internal padding.

sections.name: notice-bar
sections.description: Thin notification banner at top with blue background (#00194a). Temporary site notice with megaphone icon.

sections.name: header
sections.description: White background, logo left (청와대 emblem + Korean text), horizontal nav center-right (대통령/청와대/미디어/뉴스룸/정보공개), font-size toggle far right. Clean, minimal.

sections.name: hero-slider
sections.description: Full-width split layout. Left: large headline text (68px) + description + '자세히보기' CTA button. Right: editorial photo/card news image. Swiper carousel with 10 slides. Slide counter (01—10) with prev/pause/next controls.

sections.name: schedule
sections.description: Purple-blue-pink gradient background. Shows today's presidential schedule with date, time, event, location. Swiper carousel. Subtle '+ 더보기' link.

sections.name: cta-banners
sections.description: Two side-by-side CTA blocks. Left: blue (#0080fb) bg - '대통령 취임선서'. Right: dark navy (#00205c) bg - '국민주권예산'. Each with quote text above, title, arrow icon right.

sections.name: briefing
sections.description: White bg, '청와대 브리핑' heading in Nanum_Myeongjo serif. Horizontal card carousel (Swiper). Each card: title (truncated 2 lines), description (truncated 2 lines), date. Arrow navigation buttons (circle, navy bg).

sections.name: moments
sections.description: '대통령의 순간들' in Nanum_Myeongjo. Subtitle + two category links (사진/영상). Bento-grid layout: 2-column photo cards with overlay text + date. Below: 2 video thumbnails with play button overlay + titles.

sections.name: footer
sections.description: Minimal. Light gray bg (#f5f6fb). Address text centered. Copyright. Scroll-to-top circle button right.

layout.max_width: No explicit max-width container visible; content sections use internal padding (40-60px horizontal)
layout.whitespace_density: Generous. Large vertical spacing between sections (60-130px). Hero section uses significant whitespace around headline.
layout.section_flow: Vertical stack, full-width. Alternating: white → gradient → dark navy → white → dark. Creates visual rhythm through background color changes.

scroll_effects: Swiper carousels for hero, schedule, and briefing sections
hover_patterns: Cards: likely scale or shadow transition (briefing cards)
Navigation links: underline or color change
micro_interactions: Scroll-to-top button with circular arrow icon

brand_voice.tone: Formal, authoritative, yet approachable. Presidential dignity with public service warmth. Emotionally resonant headlines.
brand_voice.perspective: First-person plural ('우리는') and institutional ('정부는'). Direct address to citizens ('국민 여러분').
brand_voice.headline_pattern: Declarative statements or emotional appeals. Often multi-line Korean headlines breaking at natural word boundaries. Mix of policy announcements and personal messages.
brand_voice.cta_style: Understated. '자세히보기' (View details) with arrow. Rounded pill buttons (#00205c bg, white text, border-radius 28px). Secondary CTAs use text+arrow pattern.
brand_voice.copy_density: Medium. Hero shows full headline + 2-line description. Briefing cards show truncated previews. Photo sections use minimal text overlay.
brand_voice.social_proof_style: Schedule section serves as activity proof ('국민과 함께하는 오늘'). Photo/video sections document presidential activities as social proof of governance.
